## Personality

Elizabeth Russell is described as a pleasant, smart individual who is also a creature of mirth. Despite these qualities, she possesses a fierce disposition and a terrible temper.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P4](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P48](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0048), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063)_

## History

Elizabeth Russell was a guest of her uncle, a Government official residing in [Port Marlow](../codex/places.md#port-marlow), during the year the Prince of Wales visited the [Island](../codex/places.md#brendan-s-island). While there, she led the Prince to dance with her at a ball, which enraged every unchosen woman present. She ultimately never married due to her fierce disposition, fearing that peaceful cohabitation with a husband would be impossible.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063)_

### [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/elizabeth-russell--uncle-saul.md)

Captain Saul is a close companion of Elizabeth. He is known for sharing stories of his life at sea, such as how he rescued his cat, [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), and for showing off his collection of curiosities. Despite his fond recollections of past companions and yearning for adventure, he maintains a warm relationship as a trusted friend.
